Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the inspection checklist I1 for auxiliary board, common 
 part turbine house which must be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 
 in the title block.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Zakaria Mohamed Abd El-Reheem, 
 accepted by eng. Osama Ahmad Hassanein, approved by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud 
 Abd El-Gaber head sector of Aswan Dam 1,2 and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama 
 Soliman
HPGC MPIS coordinator and 
 inspection & quality control's general director.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles, and 
 rubber glove. ...etc
Tools 
and Equipment
Digital ammeter
Screw driver
Computer
Vaccum cleaner
Work to be 
carried out
Preparation
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual
First make dry clean (0CBD 01: 0CBD06) by vacuum cleaner
Retighten the terminals in (0CBD01 : 0CBD 06)
DC/DC converter (230/48/24 Vdc) 
 ( )
Voltage regulator (24/5 Vdc) 
 ( )
Backup battery (230 Vac / 24 Vdc) 
 ( )
Check led"s on front panel of CPU as
Run (green led) on 
 ( )
PBC (yellow led) on 
 ( )
BATT (green led) on 
 ( )
HLT (yellow led) off 
 ( )
To (yellow led) off 
 ( )
(P1 operation mode) 
 ( )

A1,B1 A2,B2 (yellow led) flickering 
 ( )

 ( )
F (red led) off 
 ( )
F (red led) off 
 ( )
Active signal (yellow led) on 
 ( )

 ( )
F (red led) off 
 ( )
Switch off power supply
Dismantle all electronic boards and clean it by using vacuum cleaner
Check the jumpers
Install the boards
Switch on power supply
Make a function test for alarm system
Ventilation Fans
Switch off power supply
Dismantle the fans
Make a clean and used spray with oil to lubricate the fan
Install the fan
Connect the power supply
Function Test
Use a computer to check the change over time (11 second)
Check and record the actual value for change over time between the signal of 
 first stage under voltage for 0.4 kv bus bar appear and stand by circuit 
 breaker on during the maintenance of 0.4 kv CB and auxiliary transformers 
 (11/0.4 kv)
